name: influencers-club
description:
Influencers Club connects your AI assistant to creator data across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and OnlyFans. Ask in plain language, “find fitness creators on Instagram with 100k+ followers and 3%+ engagement”, and get back a ranked list you can act on.

The server provides 33 tools: creator discovery with semantic search and filters for followers, engagement, location, and language; profile enrichment at different depths, from a quick profile to full analytics with contact details, audience demographics, and past brand deals; recent posts with engagement metrics; audience-overlap comparison between creators; lookalike search to find creators similar to one that already performs well; and team exclusion lists that keep creators you’ve already contacted out of your searches.

Results come from the Influencers Club API and are billed against your account credits, appearing in your dashboard exactly as if you ran them there. Built for influencer marketers, agencies, talent managers, and founders doing campaign research, prospecting, and creator vetting.
